name: @animastor/web-player
description: Preact/Web UI module: Animastor Web Player — the browser playback engine (queue/preload/gapless/IU-cycling/state machine/video buffer gate) plus the Play surface. NOT a platform-independent or domain module: media elements (HTMLAudioElement/HTMLVideoElement), Cache API, requestAnimationFrame, sessionStorage, document.visibilitychange and the desktop shell fork are web-browser specifics. All host capabilities arrive ONLY via the injected PlayerPorts contract (session, generation, position, invalidations, http, shellMode, i18n, icons). The Android player (PlaybackViewModel.kt/PlayFragment.kt) is a separate parity implementation — out of scope (parity is contractual, per ANDROID_WEB_PARITY.md). The backend playback contour lives in @animastor/player — HTTP is the contract; this package must NOT depend on it.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
